comment: Entries the runs of results/logins-long-2026-11-17 would add to observed/manifest.json (T-75, branch campaign/logins-long). runs: appended to runs; excluded: appended to excluded. Nothing here is a result. The runs that continue logins-2026-11-17/LC1 - LC4 and LM1, LM3 need those as runs: LC1 - LC4 are runs in that part's entries, LM1 and LM3 are in its excluded and must move to runs (they were held back to be published with ML1 and ML3, as one evaluation each, whatever those show). CL1, CL3, ML1 and ML3 were cut off by a restart of the Mac: their files are the probes' progress files.

runs.note: probe 0.3.3 through CLIProxyAPI, the request of LC1 with ages out to 24 h (the long schedule plus 24 h). The probe sent prompt_cache_retention "24h" (OpenAI's extended retention, as a client asking for the long cache sends it); CLIProxyAPI deletes it before the Codex login, so the login received the plain request, recorded with no option. Proof: the Codex translator deletes prompt_cache_options and prompt_cache_retention from every OpenAI Responses request (commits 2ab25eae "strip unsupported prompt_cache_options from OpenAI Responses requests", #4915, and 2005788f "filter out prompt_cache_retention in OpenAI->Codex responses request conversion", #5068; codex_executor_request.go: "OAuth and SIWC credentials reject prompt_cache_options, so they keep the translator's removal"), and at 18:23 local the login answered 200 to prompt_cache_retention "bogus-retention" and prompt_cache_options.ttl "bogus-ttl" while it refused an unknown field with 400 "Unsupported parameter" (fields-codex.jsonl). Pinned to the Codex login by a temporary alias probe/gpt-6.1-sol on that login only (/v1/models?include=accounts lists only the Codex login for it; the plain id also has an OpenAI API key); every answer's X-CPA-AUTH-KIND was oauth, and the OpenAI API key's counter stayed at 0. Served by build ngvoicu-local-c52243ab (process of 18:09:07 local) until the owner restarted the proxy at 18:38:51 local, build ngvoicu-local-4c071f30 (the same plus one commit for the WebSocket auth-kind event, nothing in this request path) after that. Cut off: the 4-, 8- and 12-hour checks were refused by CLIProxyAPI itself (HTTP 400 "unknown provider for model probe/gpt-6.1-sol"; the owner's configuration of 20:50 local had excluded gpt-6.1-sol from the Codex login; nothing reached OpenAI), and the Mac was restarted at 10:16 local on 2026-11-18, before the 24-hour check, which ended the run. The run file is the probe's progress file as the restart left it (status "running"), unchanged. A check that errored counts neither warm nor cold, so this run adds data to 2 h only: no data at 4, 8, 12 or 24 h. The published 0 means that there is no tested age through which every check hit, not that this route does not cache. Misses at 2.5 minutes came back on this login without load at priming: GS1 and GA1 (logins-gpt-6-2-2026-11-17, GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra) missed 1 of 3 at 2.5 minutes with no large request before the priming, the two models primed one after the other, and nothing else using the login (its request counter rose by exactly their own requests), so load at priming does not explain the misses. Their cause is not established.

continues LM1 (warm in all its checks to 2 h), planned at 4, 8, 12 and 24 h, made as it was: the plain probe, no body extra; CLIProxyAPI's payload rule for muse-* adds prompt_cache_retention "24h" to every request to the Meta login. muse-* ids have one account, the Meta login (/v1/models?include=accounts); every answer's X-CPA-AUTH-KIND was oauth. The probe also checks at 2.5, 5 and 7.5 min (always), which adds samples to those ages of LM1. Served by build ngvoicu-local-c52243ab (process of 18:09:07 local) until the owner restarted the proxy at 18:38:51 local, build ngvoicu-local-4c071f30 (the same plus one commit for the WebSocket auth-kind event, nothing in this request path) after that. Cut off: all three 8-hour checks failed after their retries (HTTP 504 from CLIProxyAPI between 02:32 and 02:58 local on 2026-11-18: its lookup of Meta's API host timed out), and the Mac was restarted at 10:16 local on 2026-11-18, before the 24-hour check, which ended the run. The run file is the probe's progress file as the restart left it (status "running"), unchanged. A check that errored counts neither warm nor cold, so this run has data at 2.5, 5, 7.5 min, 4 h and 12 h, none at 8 h or 24 h. LM1 and this run are published together, as one evaluation, whatever they show (decided on 2026-11-17, before any of this run's later checks).

excluded.reason: gemini-3.8-flash-tiered on the Antigravity login: Google answered 503 MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED ("No capacity available for model ... on the server", then CLIProxyAPI's auth_unavailable for it) to every request from 18:28:54 local; the run could not answer its control in 10 minutes and was ended by the chief's rule at 18:38:48. No run file; its log is AG4-2026-11-17T16-28-48.not-primed.log. Google's server capacity, not the account: no 429, no refusal of the login.

excluded.id: logins-long-2026-11-17/codex-subscription long setting (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6.1-terra, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-luna)
excluded.reason: Not measured because it does not exist on this route through CLIProxyAPI: the proxy deletes both prompt_cache_retention and prompt_cache_options from every Codex request to the login (commits 2ab25eae and 2005788f; codex_executor_request.go: "OAuth and SIWC credentials reject prompt_cache_options, so they keep the translator's removal"; only an OpenAI API key gets a client's prompt_cache_options.ttl back, PR #7609), and on 2026-11-17 18:23 local (build ngvoicu-local-c52243ab) the login answered 200 to prompt_cache_retention "24h" and "bogus-retention", prompt_cache_options.ttl "12h" and "bogus-ttl", while it refused an unknown field with 400 "Unsupported parameter" (fields-codex.jsonl). A client that asks gets the plain cache: CL1 - CL4 are recorded as plain runs (removed_by_proxy).

excluded.id: logins-long-2026-11-17/devin long setting (all 17 models of the devin provider)
excluded.reason: Not measured because it does not exist on this route: CLIProxyAPI rebuilds every Devin request as Devin's protobuf (internal/runtime/executor/helps/devin_wire.go, BuildDevinGetChatMessageRequest, build ngvoicu-local-c52243ab): system prompt, messages, tools, max tokens, temperature, session id, the cascade id (the cache key) and the model; no field for a cache lifetime, and cache_control markers are skipped when the content is read. On 2026-11-17 18:24 local devin/swe-2 (Responses format) answered 200 with the same 471 input tokens to no field, prompt_cache_retention "24h" and "bogus-retention", prompt_cache_options.ttl "bogus-ttl" and an unknown top-level field; devin/claude-haiku-5-5 (Claude's format) answered 200 to a cache marker with ttl "1h" and with ttl "bogus-ttl" (Anthropic refuses an invalid ttl with 400) (fields-devin.jsonl). A long run would send Devin exactly what a short run sends, so by the chief's decision none was made.
